thread:
maria: APAC GPU queueing spike — multiple inference pools showing high pending requests and p99 token latencies. seeing node cordons in apac-edge-1 (NIC errors). raising for visibility, thinking we should steer at GSLB while we evacuate.
alertbot: [ALERT] apac-edge-1: gpu-utilization=98% pending-reqs=1.2k p99-latency=850ms — investigate: https://ops.redwood/alerts/ALERT-9832 :rotating_light:
kevin: copy. do we have capacity headroom in apac other zones? or should we spread to eu/na?
jon: apac-other zones are also stretched. eu has ~25% spare on general-purpose pools, na has ~40%. but both have different model variants pinned; need to confirm compatibility for fallback.
anna: short-term mitigation: steer 50% of traffic to na, 30% to eu, keep 20% to apac for low-latency traffic. also enable q4/o2 quantized variants for heavy models to reduce per-token cost. this will increase token error risk slightly but keeps service alive.
sam: running runbook step 2 (gslb weight adjust dry-run). command: ```
# dry-run
routectl set-weights --from apac --to eu=30,na=50,apac=20 --dry-run
```
routectl-bot: dry-run OK. estimated effect: apac traffic -60%, projected p99 down to ~260ms in 5m window.
kevin: sounds good. any config needed for model pinning? if na doesn't have the exact model version we should fallback to a compatible older commit. who owns that?
jon: model-ops confirmed: we have compatible v1.3 (fp16) in na and eu. fallback plan: if model mismatch, runtime will map to v1.3 with semantic fallbacks. we should notify clients about potential perf delta.
maria: prioritizing realtime customers to remain in apac. update routing policy to route by tag: latencysensitive->apac(keep 80%), default->steer as anna suggested.
sam: executing change now. command: ```
# apply weights
routectl set-weights --from apac --to eu=30,na=50,apac=20 --policy default
routectl set-policy --policy realtime --rules "client_tag:latencysensitive -> apac=80,na=20"
```
routectl-bot: applying weights... submitted change id=chg-20260318-01. propagation expected ~20s per edge pool.
deploy-bot: rollout started for routing change chg-20260318-01 by sam. watch for 429s and health-check drop events.
kevin: I'll watch cost dashboard — steering to na might spike token egress/GPU cost. how long can we sustain?
anna: ops estimate: temporary 2x cost on affected requests, but we'll revert when p99 stable <300ms for 15m. also enabling autoscale for dedicated pools in na to accept extra load.
jon: note: we need to keep an eye on kv-cache hit rates — cross-region steering will reduce prefix cache effectiveness and may increase token costs. add to watchlist.
maria: good point. sam, can you toggle cross-region-cache-preserve=false for this change?
sam: toggled via config: ```
infractl set feature.cross_region_cache_preserve=false --scope apac
```
sam: cache preserve disabled. cache hit-rate expected to drop ~12% based on sim.
alertbot: [INFO] routing change chg-20260318-01 started propagation. edge-nodes updating weights.
jon: monitoring metrics: p50/p95/p99 trending down in apac within 3m. queuing dropping.
kevin: cost panel shows spike but within budgeted emergency threshold. tagging finance.
finance: @kevin noted. thanks.
maria: ongoing: evacuate cordoned nodes, reprovision NICs, and drain pods from apac-edge-1. runbook step 4 in progress.
sam: drain command: ```
kubectl cordon apac-edge-1
kubectl drain apac-edge-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```
sam: drain completed for 6 nodes. provisioning request raised for replacement GPU nodes (type nvidia-a10x2) in apac-edge-1. ticket #INC-4221.
anna: once nodes back, we should run perf test with synthetic workload before restoring weights.
jon: agree. propose gradual restore: +20% every 10m and monitor p99/cpu/gpu-saturation + client error rate.
kevin: let's also capture logs from NIC firmware on the failed nodes and open a hardware ticket with cloud provider.
maria: done. sending logs to provider. reference INC-4221.
alertbot: [RESOLVE] apac-edge-1: node health: degraded->repairing.
sam: perf smoke tests passed on new nodes in apac-edge-1. re-enable cache-preserve and start weight rollback to baseline. applying incremental weights: ```
# restore plan
routectl set-weights --from apac --to eu=20,na=30,apac=50 --policy default
```
routectl-bot: change chg-20260318-02 submitted.
kevin: monitoring cost and latency. p99 in apac stable ~210ms, global p99 ~230ms. costs normalized.
maria: thanks team. postmortem: schedule a follow-up to discuss autoscale headroom sizing and cross-region cache strategies. for now incident closed — will keep ticket open for hardware RCA. :white_check_mark: 
deploy-bot: incident chg-20260318-01 closed by maria. timeline and runbook notes pushed to #incidents-archive.
jon: +1 great work. :thumbsup:
